jobs.title: Chief of Staff
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
The Chief of Staff is a high-visibility leadership role responsible for the operational success of the SVP, General Manager’s organization. Acting as a strategic partner, you will ensure the business operates at peak velocity by driving key initiatives, improving organizational effectiveness, and aligning teams around strategic priorities. You will translate high-level goals into clear execution plans across the business, providing clarity in a fast-paced, complex environment.

This role is designed for a seasoned operator who excels at driving accountability among senior leaders and building the systems necessary to scale a SaaS business. You will identify operational gaps, mitigate risks before they impact the bottom line, and act as an extension of leadership—prioritizing, executing, and communicating critical projects to enable the executive team to operate at maximum efficiency.

** Please note that this opportunity is located in New York, NY, and requires this hire to work from our office 5 days a week. **

As a Chief of Staff You Can Expect:

- Drive the Operating Cadence: Design and manage the GM's leadership meetings, QBRs, and planning cycles to keep the team aligned and hitting KPIs.

- Force Execution: Partner with Sales, Customer Success, Account Management, Implementation, Product leaders to unblock projects and hold senior stakeholders accountable for deliverables.

- Own Plan Integrity: Keep the team aligned to the quarterly and annual plan, hold leaders accountable for the commitments behind it, and flag risk early, before it shows up as a miss in the business review.

- Drive Alignment & Follow-Through: Ensure decisions and commitments made in leadership meetings are clearly communicated across the team, tracked to completion, and actually followed through on, closing the loop between what was decided and what gets done.

- Prioritize Ruthlessly: Act as a surrogate for the GM in high-level meetings, surfacing critical risks early and filtering out noise to focus the organization on top priorities.

- Build Systems & Visibility: Develop dashboards and reporting structures that provide real-time clarity on business health and cross-functional performance.

- Lead Special Projects: Own high-impact, ambiguous initiatives that don’t have a natural home or that cross enough functions to need a neutral, accountable owner (e.g., market expansion research, internal restructuring, or post-launch retrospectives).

- Facilitate High-Stakes Decisions: Prepare briefing materials, research, and frameworks that enable the GM to make fast, informed decisions.

To Thrive in This Role, You’ll Need:

- 5+ years experience in high-growth SaaS operator roles (e.g., BizOps, Product Ops, RevOps, or a prior CoS/Founder role) OR deep domain expertise in SaaS business models and operations gained from consulting and private/growth equity backgrounds.

- Executive Presence: The confidence to challenge senior leaders and the diplomacy to drive consensus across competing departments.

- Clarity from Chaos: A proven ability to walk into an ambiguous environment and build the structure, processes, and documentation needed to scale.

- Deep SaaS Literacy: Fluency in the operational and financial levers of a SaaS P&L (churn, NRR, CAC, bookings attainment, unit economics) and the metrics that drive them.

- Trust & Discretion: You'll see everything before anyone else does.  Sound judgment about what moves where, and the discretion to hold it appropriately.

- Relentless, Not Just Organized: Airtight organization paired with the willingness to push people, you're the one chasing follow-through until the team is in motion, without losing the room.

- Strong Judgment: You know when to handle a situation yourself and when to escalate to the GM.

What VTS Values & How We Show It

- Strive for Excellence  - We know your potential is unlimited. Take advantage of our executive coaches and our training and career development programs available to all employees!

- Be Customer Obsessed - We’re employee obsessed too! VTS offers competitive compensation, comprehensive health benefits (including dental and vision), pre-tax commuter benefits, and a 401(k) plan. Not to mention the fun stuff - quarterly happy hours, wellness events, clubs, and team lunches!

- Be Curious  - Benefit from a culture that promotes new learning. VTS offers an education stipend to all employees!

- Move as One  - We work in an open floor plan to promote cross-functional collaboration.

- Take Ownership  - Be an owner of the company you’re building with our equity packages.

- Appreciate the Difference  - VTS embraces and celebrates diversity. We understand the importance of a strong work-life balance. We offer a flexible PTO policy, generous family leave program, and more!

ABOUT VTS

VTS is the only AI-driven technology platform enabling intelligent real estate by unifying industry professionals, investors, and their customers at scale. In 2013, VTS revolutionized commercial real estate leasing operations with what is now VTS Lease. Today, VTS AI is the largest first-party insights and collaboration engine in the industry, transforming how strategic decisions are made and executed by the real estate industry globally.

With the VTS Platform, consisting of VTS Lease , VTS Market , VTS Activate , and VTS Data , every stakeholder in real estate is given real-time market information and workflow tools to do their job with unparalleled speed and intelligence. VTS is the global leader, with more than 60% of Class A office space in the U.S., and 13 billion square feet of office, residential, retail, and industrial space is managed through the platform worldwide. VTS is utilized by over 45,000 professionals and over 1.2 million total users each day, including industry-leading customers such as Blackstone, Brookfield Properties, LaSalle Investment Management, Hines, BXP, Oxford Properties, JLL, and CBRE.

VTS maintains offices in New York City, London, Toronto, Chicago.

To learn more about VTS and view our open roles, visit us at vts.com or follow us on Instagram (@WeAreVTS) or LinkedIn.

jobs.title: Director of Growth Marketing
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
VTS is looking for a Director of Growth Marketing to be the core driver of our unified GTM motion, working in close partnership with Sales, Customer Success, and Revenue Operations. You've built a growth motion from the ground up before, and you know how to set direction while staying close enough to the work to execute it yourself.

You'll own the integrated campaigns and how we bring them to market, translating that into what goes out through our own marketing channels (owned and paid). You'll work closely with sales and revenue operations to make sure the right message, content, and actions show up throughout the entire GTM funnel, moving target accounts from unaware to aware to actively engaged, and measuring what actually matters.

Reporting to the VP of Marketing, you'll work alongside a strong marketing team and set the strategic direction for growth while remaining hands-on, using AI and other tools to prototype ideas, test messaging, and explore new channels and activations before scaling them.

** Please note that this opportunity is located in New York, NY, and requires this hire to work from our office 4 days a week. **

What Makes This Job Awesome? You will...

- Own and build the growth motion, including identifying and launching the right channels and tactics for VTS's key business segments and buyer personas.

- Build and launch full-funnel campaigns through the growth channels, and partner with the rest of the GTM team on distribution across every touchpoint, so buyers get one unified message.

- Translate product positioning, market trends, and sales intelligence into campaign concepts that actually move buyers.

- Create the different types of content and messaging that fuel your campaigns, and know how to brief others clearly when you need to bring someone else in.

- Own the campaign calendar: prioritize programs based on business impact, pipeline goals, and what's happening in the market.

- Partner tightly with sales to understand where deals get stuck, what accounts need attention, and how marketing can help move them.

- Define and own how marketing success is measured in a modern buying environment - think account engagement, pipeline influence, buyer journey progression, and revenue impact rather than traditional lead volume metrics. Work closely with Revenue Operations and GTM Engineering to build the instrumentation, attribution models, and reporting frameworks that connect campaign activity to real business outcomes.

- Oversee distribution and amplification across paid and organic channels, including paid media, SEO, email, social, content, and beyond. You don't need to pull every lever yourself, but you need to deeply understand how each works, how they interact, and how to get the most out of the agencies and partners executing against your strategy.

- Leverage AI tools to move fast - rapidly prototype campaign concepts, test messaging and creative, explore new channels and activations, and iterate without always needing to wait on resources. You'll have a creative team to work with, but you should be comfortable using AI to get to a first version, test a hypothesis, or launch something scrappy before scaling it.

- Build and leverage cross-functional relationships, including activating internal thought leaders and execs to help shape narrative, amplify campaigns, and bring the VTS point of view to market authentically.

What Makes You a Great Fit?

- 7-10 years in B2B marketing, with meaningful experience in growth marketing, demand generation, or integrated campaign strategy at a SaaS or technology company

- Have built and run a growth motion from the ground up, not just executed campaigns through channels already in place

- Have incorporated AI into how you research, write, test, and build, and are always looking for ways to move faster and get to better work.

- A strong, versatile writer: you can produce campaign copy, messaging, and content yourself across formats, not just brief someone else to do it.

- Deep understanding of the full funnel: how enterprise or mid-market buyers move from awareness to consideration to purchase, and how marketing accelerates that at every stage

- Experience working closely with sales: you've been in deal reviews, you understand the pipeline, and sales teams trust your work

- Ability to lead and hold agencies accountable across paid and organic channels; you've managed vendor relationships and know when they're performing

- Strong analytical instincts where you’ve defined your own success metrics, pulled your own data, and made decisions based on what's actually working.

- An integrated campaign thinker: you start with the audience and the insight, not the channel

- Background that includes both startup and larger company experience — you know how to move fast, own a lot, and operate without a lot of infrastructure, but you also have exposure to what good looks like at scale

jobs.title: Senior Content Marketing Manager
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
VTS is looking for a Senior Content Marketing Manager to own content strategy across the full marketing funnel. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for someone who can both set the content strategy and produce most of it themselves — from long- and short-form writing to video storyboarding and executive presentations. You'll shape how VTS shows up across every format and channel, partnering closely with Growth Marketing, Product Marketing, and cross-functional teams including Executives, Sales, and Customer Success to make sure content connects to what the business actually needs.

** Please note that this opportunity is located in New York, NY, and requires this hire to work from our office 4 days a week. **

What Makes This Job Awesome? You will...

- Own VTS's content strategy end-to-end: define the right mix of long-form, short-form, video, employee-generated content across the funnel, from top-of-funnel awareness through customer expansion.

- Take what you hear from executives, sales, customers, and prospects and work with the VP of Marketing to translate it into our overall messaging. Then bring that messaging to life in decks, presentations, and content for internal and external audiences.

- Produce the majority of our content yourself, especially written work, while knowing when to bring in our creative and video teams, or agency support, for storyboarding, production, or specialized formats.

- Develop and own our customer content program (case studies, customer stories, and other proof points), showcasing customer outcomes in ways that support both new business and expansion

- Own social content strategy and execution, including employee-generated content and thought leadership posting.

- Drive SEO and AEO strategy across our website, landing pages, and content, ensuring VTS shows up in both traditional search and AI-driven answer engines.

- Partner closely with Growth Marketing to produce the right content for our paid and owned channels, bringing a point of view on how content should be distributed to reach the right audience, and with Product Marketing to build materials that support product launches.

- Partner with the events team to turn events and other high-visibility marketing moments into content with a longer lifetime, extending their value well beyond the moment itself.

What Makes You a Great Fit?

- 5-8 years of B2B marketing experience with breadth across content formats — long-form, short-form, video, social, and customer content — rather than depth in a single specialty like case studies alone.

- A strong, versatile writer who can produce polished content independently, not just direct others to produce it.

- Comfortable holding executive-facing conversations and taking a point of view on messaging, translating what you hear from stakeholders into a clear narrative.

- A point of view on content distribution — how the right piece reaches the right audience through the right channel.

- Fluent with AI tools (e.g., Claude) as part of your everyday workflow, using them to scale output and move faster, not as an occasional aid.

- Experience with SEO and emerging AEO/answer-engine optimization practices.

- Some experience with decks and presentations — a plus, not a requirement; storytelling instinct matters more than design polish.

- Startup or enterprise background both work, provided you bring range across content types rather than a single area of specialization.

- Comfortable operating in a fast-moving, scrappy environment where you'll both set strategy and roll up your sleeves to execute it.
